answer_1.quote: This work focuses on elaborative simplification, i.e., explaining or elaborating difficult concepts or content during the simplification process...

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation We first evaluate generated questions with two automatic measures, BERTScore and BLEU...

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation We further perform human evaluation across three systems...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judge questions along two criteria: (1) Is the question reasonable to ask given the current context? (2) Is this question answered by the elaboration? For elaborations, they judge: (1) coherent continuation of discourse; (2) elaboration-like or explanationlike.
